description: The Busan fitness-association gathering is reported as about 50 in S419, a Dong-A Ilbo article by Kim So-young and Lee Ji-woon; News1 is credited only for a photo/caption, and the approximate figure leaves the exact threshold uncertain. A Chosun search-result excerpt suggests about 50 screen-golf operators, but its article body was not readable and that figure remains unverified.
required_followup: Seek accessible independent reporting, photographs, organizer records, or municipal records that establish simultaneous attendance for each group.

description: Jan. 6 reporting distinguishes fitness operators and screen-golf owners at Busan City Hall, while a Chosun search-only excerpt describes separate front/rear gate actions. The readable S419 Dong-A Ilbo article by Kim So-young and Lee Ji-woon, with News1 credited only for a photo/caption, does not resolve whether groups assembled separately or how the local actions related; physical end times are unknown.
required_followup: Read an accessible independent local report or organizer record and check the actions before and after Jan. 6.

description: S418 and S420 are separately attributed News1-origin reports. S419 is by Dong-A Ilbo reporters Kim So-young and Lee Ji-woon, with News1 credited only for a photo/caption; its written-reporting relationship to S418 and S420 is not established, so S419 is not treated as automatic independent corroboration. The Chosun result is a potentially independent lead, but its body was not readable, so it does not yet corroborate the Busan count or event boundaries.
required_followup: Find a readable, independent local report or organizer/municipal record; retain S418 and S420’s separate News1 attribution and do not assume S419 is either News1-origin or independent.

description: The web search engine often returned unrelated later-2021 material despite January terms, especially for the second half of the month. Result headers are preserved for 24 English and Korean queries, but this search behavior leaves discovery incomplete.
required_followup: If resuming, search regional news archives and date-specific Korean terms and check publication dates in opened sources.

description: The reviewed leads cover business-owner actions in Seoul and Busan and railway labor actions in Wonju, Seoul, Daejeon, Gwangju, and Busan. Student, farmer, environmental, transport, disability-rights, and other regional actions remain incompletely covered; no absence claim is warranted.
required_followup: Search additional sectors and regions using local Korean reporting and the official baseline/archives when accessible.

description: KRWU confirms Jan. 4 and Jan. 12 press conferences, a Seoul Station sit-in beginning no later than Jan. 9, and Jan. 15 multi-station rallies, but gives no turnout for any gathering. Yonhap's approximately 1,000 is strike-wide and cannot be assigned to a rally or sit-in.
required_followup: Find attendance estimates specific to each gathering or station; do not substitute strike membership or participation.

description: The railway strike began in November 2020; the Jan. 11 chronology calls the Seoul Station sit-in its third day, and Yonhap says the all-member strike shifted to cadre action on Jan. 15. The broader campaign's later physical boundary is unknown, and these facts do not resolve whether each January gathering is a distinct campaign or episode.
required_followup: Check the February chronology and accessible follow-up reporting for any later physical actions and keep event-level attendance and boundaries separate.

description: A Hankyoreh21 field report confirms Itaewon merchants' Jan. 9 press conference seeking COVID-rule adjustment but gives no attendance or exact venue.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous attendance reporting, an organizer account, or photographs that establish simultaneous turnout and physical end.

description: Yonhap reports Busan's Jan. 10 decision to partially reopen indoor sports facilities from Jan. 11 and notes recent protests. The source does not identify an event-specific meeting or attribute the change to the Jan. 6 association, so accommodation remains unknown.
required_followup: Look for a city or association account linking the policy change to a specific group or meeting; do not infer event-level accommodation from timing alone.

description: An MK search result appeared to target a January 2021 article, but opening returned a cache miss and the exact URL redirected on an HTTP 200 request to an Oct. 20, 2021 article at https://www.mk.co.kr/news/society/10067300. It is a wrong-month result and not January evidence.
required_followup: No follow-up for January coding; retain the observed redirect and exclude the October report.

description: A search-result page titled as a 2021 disability-rights public-transport occupation returned HTTP 403 when opened. No event date, January relevance, turnout, or content could be verified; no retry or bypass was attempted.
required_followup: If this sector remains in scope, seek a separate accessible contemporaneous source without retrying the denied page.

description: OhmyNews's Jan. 28 report about the Jan. 15 railway rallies was cross-posted on Newscham under the same reporter. The two URLs are one reporting origin, not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Use genuinely independent reporting or primary organizer records if rally turnout or details are found.
